newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise says Suez divestments not over.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise says Suez divestments not over.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux chairman Jerome Monod said on Thursday a process of divestment by likely merger partner Suez from the financial sector did not yet look finished.
"For Suez, which has pulled out of many financial activities...the story is not yet over," Monod told a news conference on his group's results.
He declined to elaborate on what could happen in terms of such divestments following a merger between Lyonnaise and Suez.
The two firms are in merger talks and meet on April 11 to consider a plan to join forces.
